types.name: CloakedAgentState
docs: Cloaked Agent state - stores constraints and spending tracking
Supports two ownership modes:
- Standard mode: owner = Some(wallet), owner_commitment = [0; 32]
- Private mode: owner = None, owner_commitment = hash(secret)

fields.name: owner
docs: Human wallet - full control over agent (None for private mode)

fields.name: owner_commitment
docs: Commitment hash for private mode ownership (zeros for standard mode)
In private mode: commitment = poseidon(agent_secret)

fields.name: delegate
docs: Agent key - can spend within limits

fields.name: max_per_tx
docs: Max lamports per transaction (0 = unlimited)

fields.name: daily_limit
docs: Max lamports per day (0 = unlimited)

fields.name: total_limit
docs: Max lifetime lamports (0 = unlimited)

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp expiration (0 = never)

fields.name: frozen
docs: Emergency stop

fields.name: total_spent
docs: Lifetime spending

fields.name: daily_spent
docs: Today's spending

fields.name: last_day
docs: Day tracker for reset (unix_timestamp / SECONDS_PER_DAY)

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

docs: Per-token constraints and spending tracking
